name: ent-clearing
description: The settlement layer of ledger row #12, executed: the coin, the notary, and the binding market were already books — this page is the CLEARING. Redemption: teleportation burns the coin to deliver an unknown qubit (fidelity exact over pure and mixed payloads; post-trade pairwise concurrence exactly 0; the goods do not move until the 2-bit classical leg settles — Bob's pre-bits marginal is exactly I/2). Reverse quote: dense coding buys exactly 2 cbits with 1 transmitted qubit and RETURNS the coin as a known Bell pair (post-decode concurrence exactly 1) — the coin is fuel in one trade and catalyst in the other, and that asymmetry is the parity 1 ebit = 1 qubit = 2 cbits. Netting: a weak coin of concurrence 2*sqrt(l0*l1) nets to a standard coin with probability exactly 2*l_min (Procrustean filter, success branch exactly |Phi+>, failure a worthless product state; mixed-coin netting stays asymptotic, BBPS96 quoted). The mint wall: local channels never raise E_F (200-trial census; the monotonicity is Vidal00, cited), a single global CNOT mints C 0->1 — the clearing house moves, spends, nets; it never prints. The checker enforces the board laws; the renderer refuses illegal boards.
